DEAD SIGNAL INTERACTIVE · TUCSON, AZ

Studio Guild, Business Info & Town Arcade

Dead Signal is a veteran-founded independent studio in Tucson, Arizona created by Michael Arlotta. Instead of a static brochure, our three studio frequencies live inside the buildings of Dead Signal Valley.

91.2 MHz · DIVISION 01 Town Hall: Resonance Hall & Riverglass Studio

Fortnite Experiences (Built for Another Round)

Readable spaces, deliberate routes, and moments that bring players back. We study how a 3D environment becomes a competitive or social place worth playing.

  • Environment Studies (R&D): Spatial layout, sightline flow, and courtyard readability studies.
  • Scrapline & Poolday / Gun Game: Fast-paced arena and combat loop experiments.
97.6 MHz · DIVISION 02 Town Hall: Afterglow Arcade & Coppercoil Workshop

Web Games & Game Technology (Make the Connection)

Browser games that load fast and tools that connect a creative workflow. Built locally, verified deterministically, and playable right inside the town arcade.

  • Operation Sweeper (minesweeper.life): Web game with an exact dense-board logical solver and native tutorials.
  • Play Operation Sweeper
  • Signal Hunt: 30-second observatory frequency catcher playable in the tab above.
  • DSI Relay & MCP Watchtower: Developer workflow diagnostics and local verification tools.
104.3 MHz · DIVISION 03 Town Hall: Bell-Tower Plaza & Valley Station

Youth Esports Development (The Next Generation)

Talent needs more than a fast computer. Our Tucson pilot program brings dependable hardware, structured practice rhythms, and responsible mentorship into one path.

  • Three Foundations: Dependable competitive setup (Equipment), balanced session structure (Practice), and family/player guidance (Support).
  • Status: Planning stage pilot in Tucson, AZ. No donations or payments are solicited on this site.

TRAINING STUDIO · 104.3 MHz

Build a Balanced Practice Session

Adjust total session length to calculate a sustainable rhythm of focused drills, VOD/match review, and physical reset breaks.

36 min PRACTICE (60%) Mechanics, communication & deliberate in-game reps
15 min REVIEW (25%) Replay analysis, decision check & positioning notes
9 min BREAKS (15%) Eye rest, hydration, posture & wrist reset
Equipment: Dependable high-refresh monitor, ergonomic peripherals, and stable local network.
Practice: Structured sessions with clear goals instead of endless unstructured grinding.
Support: Transparent scheduling and family-first accountability.

Independent by Design · Tucson, Arizona

Dead Signal Interactive LLC is a veteran-founded studio led by Michael Arlotta in Tucson, Arizona. We build walkable 3D places to play, practical web game tools, and a structured path for emerging competitors.

PAST

Poolday / Gun Game experiments, early Blender & Three.js observatory prototypes, and foundational spatial studies.

PRESENT

Dead Signal Valley interactive 3D town (15 shops, modular Meshy café, railway), Operation Sweeper solver, and DSI Relay.

FUTURE

Expanded enterable valley premises, Fortnite Scrapline arena release, and the Tucson Youth Esports pilot cohort.

Founder & Lead: Michael Arlotta (Tucson, Arizona)
